question: Which of the following countries has the "Lengthiest written Constitution"?
solution:
The answer is,** 'India'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The constitution of India is the **lengthiest written constitution **of the world, **officially accepted on 26 January 1950**.

 
 
• The **draft of the Indian Constitution** was finalized and submitted on **4 November 1947.**
 
• This **draft was adopted on 26 November 1949.**
 
• India finally implemented the new constitution on 26 January 1950 (2 months after its adoption).
 
• India Consitution has been **amended over 90 times.**
 
• There are **395 Articles in Indian Constitution**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** US Consitution** has only **7 Articles **and came into **effect on 4 March 1789.**
 
• **France** has seen many constitutions. The current one is called the **Consitution of the Fifth Republic. **
 
 
• **​**It came into **effect on 4 October 1958.**
 
 
 
• The **Australian Constitution** has 8 Chapters and it came into **effect on 1 January 1901.**
